title: Recoverable upgrade loop detection and minimal state repair for on-prem operators
creator: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Several customers running Private/VPC deployments reported clusters repeatedly entering operator-driven upgrade loops after a Helm upgrade. The operator would detect an out-of-sync CRD/ConfigMap, attempt reconciliation, and re-trigger the upgrade path; retries caused manifest churn, certificate bumps, and eventually tenant-facing 503s or degraded pod readiness. This ticket scopes a short-term automated detection and minimal-state repair hotfix plus a medium-term operator reconciliation hardening design.
comments: 2025-01-12 - Ava Chen (creator): Filed after PagerDuty alert and two high-severity customer escalations. Initial triage: root cause appears to be non-idempotent post-upgrade hook that writes a tenant-scoped opaque ConfigMap and a subsequent operator reconcile that treats the generated ConfigMap as user-supplied state, re-running the hook. Slack incident channel: #inc-onprem-upgrade-loop. Collected customer cluster logs (s3://redwood-incidents/2025-01-12/upgrade-loop-logs).

2025-01-13 - Rohan Patel (assignee): Reproduced locally with minikube + helm v3.9. Test harness shows sequence: helm upgrade -> post-upgrade hook creates cert-secret / opaque-configmap -> operator reconcile sees missing annotation and re-invokes hook path (race condition across webhook admission and CRD status update). Created repo PR: github.com/redwood-inference/operator/compare/fix/minimal-repair (PR #4147) implementing a marker annotation and idempotent hook flow.

2025-01-14 - SRE (Lena Torres): Telemetry query added to console dashboard (query id: dq-2025-01-14-upgrade-loop) to detect >3 reconcile loops per 10m per tenant. Temporary alert created: onprem.upgrade_loop_rate.high -> PagerDuty. Recommended immediate mitigation: enable controller backoff and a quarantine flag that pauses further hook invocation for affected tenants.

2025-01-15 - Rohan Patel: Implemented minimal-state repair routine in PR: detect loop signature, create a safe-override annotation on the tenant CR that prevents hook re-entrancy, and reconcile only the delta fields. Trade-offs: this avoids full rollback (reduces blast radius) but leaves an operator-side marker that must be audited/cleared. Added automated verification steps and unit tests.
